claims.text: Methylphenidate (Ritalin): ADHD in pts ≥ 6 y and adults; narcolepsy.
claims.quote: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorders (ADHD) in pediatric patients 6 years and older and adults • Narcolepsy

claims.text: Start @ the lowest dose once a day (IR), ↑ freq wkly, usu to 2–3×/day or every 4 hrs while awake.
claims.quote: Methylphenidate is usually started at the lowest dose orally once a day (immediate-release form) for children and increased in frequency weekly, usually to approximately 2 to 3 times per day or every 4 hours during waking hours

claims.text: CI: an MAOI now or w.in 14 days of stopping one.
claims.quote: Concomitant treatment with monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs), or within 14 days following discontinuation of treatment with an MAOI
